## What happened

Describe the result and what you expected instead.

## Reproduce

Include the module version, Node version, operating system, command and minimal JSON input. Use synthetic data. Include the JSON envelope and exit status.

## Checks

Include relevant `selfcheck` output and any checks you ran. Remove private field values, credentials and personal paths.

For suspected vulnerabilities, follow SECURITY.md instead of posting details here.
